en.q: vpn will not connect. what should i do?
en.a:
1. disconnect and reconnect the VPN. try protecting all traffic or only selected services, if your app offers that choice.

2. change your internet connection: switch from Wi-Fi to mobile data or the other way around, then reconnect the VPN.

3. reset the connection types in advanced settings, then reconnect. try this a few times. if that option is missing, go to the next step.

4. if it still does not work, contact [support] — we will help.

en.q: how do I use the VPN only for the sites and apps I need?
en.a:
in Windows and Android, you can choose what uses the VPN and what uses your regular internet connection.

1. on the home screen, find “what to protect” and choose “selected”.

2. tap “choose services” and select what you need, such as YouTube and Telegram. other sites and apps will use your regular connection.

3. save the list and reconnect the VPN — saving disconnects the current connection.

to do the opposite — leave some services outside the VPN and protect everything else — choose “except selected”. these two modes keep separate lists. “all” protects all traffic.

if a site is missing, add its address: example.com for the site itself, *.example.com for its subdomains. a service can use several addresses, so a preset is usually easier.

DEMO supports all traffic only. choosing individual services is not yet available on iOS or macOS. the Chrome extension protects only the browser.

zh.q: 怎样只让需要的网站和应用使用 VPN？
zh.a:
在 Windows 和 Android 中，可以选择哪些内容走 VPN，哪些使用普通网络。

1. 在主页找到“保护哪些流量”，选择“所选”。

2. 点击“选择服务”，勾选需要的服务，例如 YouTube 和 Telegram。其他网站和应用将使用普通网络。

3. 保存列表，然后重新连接 VPN。保存时会断开当前连接。

如果想反过来，让少数服务不走 VPN、其他内容都受保护，请选择“除所选外”。这两种模式分别保存列表。“全部”会保护全部流量。

如果列表中没有需要的网站，可以添加地址：example.com 代表网站本身，*.example.com 代表其子域名。一个服务可能使用多个地址，因此通常选用预设服务更方便。

DEMO 只支持保护全部流量。iOS 和 macOS 暂不支持选择单个服务。Chrome 扩展只保护浏览器。
